New model types GroupPriority (high/medium/low, unset = nil, sortRank for the priority order) and GroupDeadline (date-only value; constructive validation makes invalid dates unrepresentable - init(year:month:day:) checks real Gregorian dates, init(parsing:) accepts only YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY/MM/DD; Comparable via ordinalValue; Codable as canonical text with decode re-validation). decisions: Unset priority is modeled as Optional absence (nil) rather than a fourth enum case, mirroring the deadline, so the unset-last sort rule cannot drift from the optional's semantics; the sort key surface is a plain Int (sortRank / ordinalValue with Int.max for unset) shared by one stable-ordering helper.

Deadline validation is constructive (failable inits are the only construction path), so the invalid-to-unset rule holds identically at every boundary: user input parse, model setter, and the lenient decode of a corrupt stored value.

Sort-tie stability is enforced by construction (enumerated + offset tie-break) instead of relying on the standard library sort, whose stability is undocumented; the spec makes stable ties a requirement, so it must not rest on an implementation accident.
